# asset-fallback-strategy (reference summary)

## Purpose
Provide a fallback strategy when an asset is unavailable, over-budget, license-blocked, or style-incompatible — without halting the recipe.

When `asset-license-checker`, `asset-style-consistency-checker`, or `glb-mobile-performance-budget` blocks an asset (or an asset is unavailable), this skill plans 2-3 actionable fallback options (replace / re-source / procedural / generative / drop-with-caveat) ordered by speed so the recipe can proceed. Any chosen replacement must re-pass `asset-license-checker` and `asset-style-consistency-checker` (plus `glb-mobile-performance-budget` when budget applies).

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/asset-fallback-strategy/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/asset-fallback-strategy/contract.json` (`v1.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `asset-and-sourcing` / `blocked-asset-replacement-planner`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- after a checker fails an asset
- when an asset cannot be acquired in time
- when budget excludes the originally-planned asset
- when license blocks an asset

## Trigger cues
- "what if we can't get this asset"
- "fallback for the model"
- "the license blocks us"
- "scaled-down asset"

## When not to use
- when no asset has failed (nothing to fall back to) → delegate to `asset-license-checker` (`references/skills/asset-license-checker.md`; nothing to fall back to)
- pure exploration (no concrete asset list) → delegate to `blender-asset-discovery-planner` (`references/skills/blender-asset-discovery-planner.md`; no concrete asset list)
- when the user wants to wait for the original asset → delegate to `product-hero-scene-planner` (`references/skills/product-hero-scene-planner.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to product-hero-scene-planner)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `blocked_asset_entry` (`object`): Asset blocked by missing source, incompatible license, style mismatch, or budget breach
- `blocking_reason` (`enum`): Primary block reason (license_rejected, source_unavailable, style_mismatch, budget_exceeded)

### Optional inputs
- `local_library_manifest` (`object`): Optional inventory of cleared local assets from asset-library-organization-planner

### Primary outputs
- `ranked_fallback_options`
- `selected_replacement_plan`
- `revalidation_routing_hooks`

## Quick-start procedure
1. read the failed asset + blocking reason
2. propose 2-3 fallback options ordered by speed-to-implement (always including `drop-with-caveat`)
3. score each option on time, brief-match, and license
4. pick one only with explicit user agreement
5. update the asset list and route any replacement back through `asset-license-checker` and `asset-style-consistency-checker` (and `glb-mobile-performance-budget` if budget-constrained)

## Handoff notes
- **[upstream_reference]** Re-source external asset → `blender-asset-discovery-planner` (`references/skills/blender-asset-discovery-planner.md`)
- **[progression]** Internal library lookup → `asset-library-organization-planner` (`references/skills/asset-library-organization-planner.md`)
- **[fallback]** License re-check on replacement → `asset-license-checker` (`references/skills/asset-license-checker.md`)
- **[fallback]** Style re-check on replacement → `asset-style-consistency-checker` (`references/skills/asset-style-consistency-checker.md`)
- **[progression]** Budget re-check on replacement → `glb-mobile-performance-budget` (`references/skills/glb-mobile-performance-budget.md`)
- **[fallback]** Scope reduction when no viable fallback exists → `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skills/blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`)
- **[fallback]** Recipe split when no viable fallback exists → `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skills/blender-recipe-decomposer.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- **Runtime boundary:** Process and planning skill only — never acquires, generates, or edits assets itself. Outputs a fallback plan and routes execution or re-verification to dedicated skills.
- Acquire, generate, or edit assets itself.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Perform license, style, or performance budget checks itself.
